candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) — Dan slovenskih bančnikov / Bančna konferenca
candidates.why_relevant: The flagship annual Slovenian banking-sector conference. Its programme and speaker list is effectively a curated roster of current senior banking job titles (uprava, direktor plačilnih storitev, vodja digitalizacije) across NLB, NKBM/OTP, SKB, Intesa, Addiko, Delavska hranilnica and Bankart, plus Banka Slovenije officials. Year-on-year diffing of speaker rosters reveals leadership moves and new org units before formal press announcements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML scrape of the conference/programme pages once per quarter plus a burst around the June event date; extract speaker name + title + institution triples and diff against the previous year's roster.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from ZBS site structure

negative_findings.description: No standing, publicly indexed 'Bančnik leta' / banker-of-the-year individual award for Slovenia was found. The award signals that do exist are institutional (The Banker 'Banka leta v Sloveniji', Euromoney awards of excellence) and are republished by the winning banks rather than by a Slovenian awarding body.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sl for nagrada/priznanje + bančništvo returned only bank-hosted awards pages (OTP banka) and generic ECB/ESRB pages; no Slovenian individual banking-leadership award body surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Individual awards would be a high-quality named-person signal for leadership moves; without one, the cell must rely on speaker rosters and institutional award pages for person-level data.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian national fintech association with a public member/speaker directory was identified. Searches for 'Fintech Slovenija združenje' returned events (FinTech Day, Finančna konferenca) and ZBS press releases, but no standalone association body.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fintech representation in Slovenia appears to run through ZBS, the startup ecosystem (startup.si, DIH Slovenia) and the regional Money Motion event rather than a national fintech association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes an expected pointer source; collection must instead aggregate across ecosystem calendars, which is noisier and needs broader keyword sweeps.

negative_findings.description: No public, machine-readable list of IEDC Bled corporate/bank partners or of banks sponsoring Executive MBA seats was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: English searches returned only third-party MBA directories (mastersportal, find-mba, best-masters) and Wikipedia; no partner or client list on an IEDC-controlled page was surfaced. Slovenian-language terms for this ('partnerji', 'korporativni programi') were not productive either.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The executive-pipeline signal for IEDC is therefore weaker than hypothesised in the cell rationale and should be de-prioritised relative to faculty scholarship calls, which are concrete and quantified.

negative_findings.description: The seed query used 'Dnevi slovenskih bankirjev'; the actual ZBS event naming appears to be 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov' (singular day, 'bančnik' not 'bankir') alongside the generic 'Bančna konferenca'. The seed term is a near-miss that would under-retrieve.
negative_findings.result_summary: Correct local terms confirmed from the ZBS site: 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov', 'Bančna konferenca', 'terminski plan', 'strokovna izobraževanja'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Glossary correction; downstream collection queries should use 'bančnik/bančniki' and both singular and plural event forms to avoid missing the flagship roster.

negative_findings.description: The ISACA Slovenia Chapter events list is hosted on the engage.isaca.org community platform, which mixes public and member-gated pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Individual event-description URLs are publicly indexed, but the main 'seznam dogodkov' page was reported as carrying administrative restrictions. Not confirmed by direct fetch — recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should target the public event-description URL pattern rather than the list page, and must not attempt to access member-only areas.

coverage_gaps.description: No conference/awards source was found that specifically covers the card-processing and payment-infrastructure actors (Bankart, Halcom, Margento, Petrol/Mercator loyalty-payments units). Bankart appears only as a co-presenter in ZBS press activity, not as an event host with its own speaker roster.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Directly crawl bankart.si and halcom.com news/events sections and check whether they host user conferences ('konferenca za uporabnike', 'partnerski dan') that publish speaker lists.

coverage_gaps.description: Most conference sites in this cell overwrite the previous year's speaker page (exception: DSI, which uses per-year subdomains). Without archiving, the year-on-year title-diffing that makes this cell valuable is impossible.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every speaker/programme page into a local store at collection time, and back-fill historical editions from the Wayback Machine before the first live run.

coverage_gaps.description: University-pipeline coverage is concentrated on University of Ljubljana faculties (EF, FRI, FE, FMF). University of Maribor (EPF, FERI) and University of Primorska (FAMNIT) career centres and their bank scholarship calls were not systematically checked, despite NKBM/OTP's Maribor base.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add EPF UM, FERI UM and UP FAMNIT career/obvestila pages to the crawl list with the same 'kadrovske štipendije / praksa' keyword filter.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference programmes are frequently distributed as PDFs and speaker bios as images/slide decks, which a plain HTML scraper will miss entirely.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Include PDF fetch-and-parse in the collection method for ZBS, DSI, INFOSEK and Finančna konferenca; flag image-only rosters for OCR.

coverage_gaps.description: The regional events most likely to feature Slovenian payments leadership (Money Motion, Balkan Business Analysis Conference) publish primarily in English/Croatian, so Slovenian-language monitoring alone will miss them, while Slovenian trade press covers them only sporadically.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the roster scrape in English for regional events and cross-index extracted affiliations against a maintained list of Slovenian bank/fintech entity names rather than relying on language filtering.

brief: Slovenia's banking/payments weak-signal event layer is small, stable and highly scrapeable: ZBS anchors the sector with the Dan slovenskih bančnikov / Bančna konferenca plus a public terminski plan, while DSI (informatics, with per-year archived speaker pages), INFOSEK (security), Večer's Finančna konferenca and the regional Money Motion in Zagreb supply the recurring speaker rosters where bank titles are stated explicitly. Professional-chapter bodies (ISACA Slovenija, IIBA Slovenia) and business-community programmes (AmCham) add a mid-senior layer of audit, BA and digital roles. The strongest and most quantified pipeline signal is not the conferences but the university channel: NLB's kadrovske-štipendije programme and the faculty-hosted scholarship calls at EF, FE, FRI and FMF (including SID Banka) name sponsoring bank, target study programme and intake window months before any vacancy appears. Main structural risks are that most conference sites overwrite last year's roster (so archiving must be built in from day one), that programmes are often PDF-only, and that no Slovenian individual banker-of-the-year award or national fintech association exists to provide a ready-made person directory.
